title: chat-server: Message/set update skips maxBodyBytes and ciphertext-field checks
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 (91672c9) L1732: 'Servers MUST reject a Message/set create or update that has an encrypted bodyType and any of these fields non-empty with an invalidProperties SetError whose properties lists each such field'. L236 maxBodyBytes applies to messages generally. message.rs applies both checks only on create (body_type_field_conflicts, body.len() > 100_000); the update path (handle_message_set update loop) checks neither. Found during JMAP-y3f2.9.
close_reason: Landed in 3425ee50 fix(chat-server): check edits like creates (batch 5, adversarially verified, CI green at 44026b06)
